description.value: 3/day, a jury-rigged cutter can make a full-attack action at the end of a charge instead of a single attack.

effect: Use full buzz saw routine at end of charge. Cannot combine with Buzzsaw Blitz.

description.value: Once every 1d6+1 rounds, a jury-rigged cutter can perform one extra buzz saw attack with each saw as part of a full attack. This ability cannot be used in conjunction with the boosted charge ability.

effect: Two regular attacks plus one extra per saw. Not usable on Boosted Charge.

description.value: Once every 1d4+1 rounds, a jury-rigged cutter can perform a whirlwind attack. When the jury-rigged cutter uses the full-attack action, it can give up it's regular attacks and instead make one melee attack at it's highest base attack bonus against each opponent within reach. It must make a separate attack roll against each opponent.

effect: Replace ordinary routine: roll independently against each enemy within reach.

description.value: A jury-rigged cutter receive a +3 racial bonus on all saving throws.
